content.title: Kraken® Roller Coaster - Orlando's Only Floorless Steel Coaster

OK Kraken® Orlando's only floorless roller coaster Born from tales that struck terror in sailors for centuries, SeaWorld Orlando's mighty Kraken® is a monster coaster like no other. Orlando’s only floorless roller coaster – is themed after a massive, mythological underwater beast unleashed from the depths of the sea. Riders’ feet dangle as they travel in open-sided seats, riding on a pedestal above the track at highway speeds to heights of more than 150 feet. Height Requirement 54" Ride Type Roller Coaster Thrill Level Extreme 5mbwrR2lozI Accessibility Guests must be 54 inches tall to ride. Guests using wheelchairs who would like to ride Kraken® should inform the Team Member at the entrance. He/she will be directed to enter through the exit located to the far left of the entrance and then up the exit ramp to the station. Guests using wheelchairs must transfer from their wheelchair to the ride vehicle. Learn More Skip the line and maximize your thrills Make every moment count.
